title: Figma + Claude

body.text: send a design screenshot from Figma for Claude to critique, or connect Figma's MCP to read the file directly
— and from the design, Claude can write component code that matches the spec.

example: "Send the checkout screen from Figma: 'Review this page's UX, find where the user might get confused or drop off'"

title: From design to code

body.text: The design-to-code gap has narrowed a lot:
attach the image + design tokens (color, font, spacing) and have it write the component
— specify the project's framework and conventions, and the result is as close to production-ready as possible.

example: "From the product card in this image, write a React component using Tailwind per the attached tokens, with responsive support"

question: How does Claude work with designs from Figma?

options.text: Analyzes screenshots or connects via MCP
It can never open a .fig file under any circumstances
Draws in Figma for us directly

question: To have the AI write code that matches the design, what should you attach?

options.text: The design image + design tokens + the framework used

question: When sending a design page for the AI to review, how should you ask?

options.text: "Find where the user might get confused or drop off"

question: To turn a Figma design into code, how do you use Claude?

options.text: Have it draft code from the spec, then review it

question: From design to code, how do you do it safely?

options.text: Review and test the AI-generated code before using it
